summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a London Stock Exchange notification of a PDMR transaction. Group Chief Executive C.S. Venkatakrishnan and his PCA, P. Venkatakrishnan, transferred 208,814 ordinary shares (nil price) as a gift for charitable causes on 2026-08-17, outside a trading venue. This is a routine disclosure of an insider share transfer, not a special situation. No corporate action, M&A, or strategic event is involved. It is reported under the SEC's Form 6-K for foreign private issuers, equivalent to a routine insider transaction filing. There is no deal to analyze or arbitrage angle; it merely tracks insider activity.
